description: List published FairWhere pages that answer “where to meet between area A and area B” in London. Each row has a winner venue, minute gap, FairWhere Score, and citation URL. Prefer this over inventing a midpoint when the user names two neighbourhoods. Only status=live pages are returned.

limit.description: Max live meet-pair pages to return.
